geometry.method: Nearest intersection against all opaque decoded production GLB triangles, including both detailed engines. Controls must be the actual first visible surface, not just exist behind another mesh.

supports.method: Downward BVH rays on decoded non-generator production triangles at the six support centers. Each pad must span the actual ground to the chassis underside; intentional contact overlaps avoid coplanar faces.
supports.classification: Inferred support arrangement, not a surveyed construction detail of the real yacht.

proxyResidual.method: Old evaluated proxy triangles from the immutable R04 Blender versus only retained electrical triangles decoded from the actual new GLB. New generator triangles are excluded; submillimetre slivers excluded as in the original derivative.

repair.method: Mean of equal-sample Cycles CORNER estimates at the same position (1um key), normal (1e-5 key), material and micro-transport mode. New generator ID2 only; hard edges and retained-front samples are not mixed.

defaultRegression.interpretation: Independent viewer sessions differ within the recorded six-pixel /32-channel edge tolerance, including one pixel with the original unpartitioned mesh. Full source face attributes and material bytes are checked independently. The same-camera movement/rest test retains its zero-difference requirement; cross-session pixel identity is not claimed.

walking.interpretation: Fixed-resolution rendering plus forced full-frame RGBA readback on SwiftShader. Synchronization/readback overhead is included; not GPU hardware FPS.

grid.privacy: VR originals remain private; published textures are authored.
grid.diagnosticLimits: SRGB differences include exposure, shadows and reflection. They are not a geometry score. Sixteen control centers are fitting landmarks, not independent holdouts.
